items.reason: Claims unvalidated timezone values cause exceptions in getSlots. Rejected issue #snapi-01 instead claims a missing override timezone silently produces an incorrect offset using the server timezone.
Claims an invalid organizerTimeZone causes an exception in checkIfIsAvailable. This is distinct from the rejected timezone-selection claim and from S7’s separate conversion site in getSlots.
Makes the same claim that checkIfIsAvailable interprets overrides using organizerTimeZone instead of each override owner’s timezone.
